Definition: a Shumathite (collectively) or descendants of Shumah
BiblicalUsage: Shumathi is a Shumathite, one of the families of Kirjath-jearim, listed among the Ithrites and the Puhites and the Mishraites, from whom came the Zareathites and the Eshtaulites. The name appears once, in the families of Judah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the families of a small town are still written down. Kirjath-jearim's clans are counted, and I hold that God keeps the roll of every household that belongs to Him.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
